Straight answer: the Avalon Q isn't one we recommend — our picks at that power rate are the Magic M. 40T at $799 or the Harlo B30 at $899, both better value per TH.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?

Magic M. 40T, $799, 40 TH/s at ~650 W — about $47 a month in power at 10¢. Ships November 21, 2026.

It's our best value per TH, and it mines solo to your own node, so a block hit is yours whole. Want me to build the cart?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Canaan Avalon Q numbers for where you live.
